newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakura says stock dip unlikely to hit earnings.
newsitem.headline: Sakura says stock dip unlikely to hit earnings.

text.p: The fall in Tokyo stock prices since last year is unlikely to have much of an impact on the earnings of Sakura Bank, Shunsaku Hashimoto, president of the bank, said on Tuesday.

"Due to the fall in stock prices up until now, our unrealised profits on stock holdings have decreased from the end of last September. But taking into account the level of unrealised profits and efforts at streamlining, (the fall of stock prices) is unlikely to have much of an effect on earnings," Hashimoto said.
